move_response_allowance_note: Same requested engine budget for both sides; reject transport round trip longer than budget plus max(100ms, budget).
thread_note: Regicide engine search is single threaded; no Threads UCI option exists

document.provenance: Self-authored reserved first-move prefixes and fixed integer seed pool. No external games, books, engines or observed outcomes. Twelve-ply continuations use Python random.Random(seed) over sorted legal UCI moves.
document.scope: Engineering promotion distribution, including unusual legal openings; not a representative human tournament distribution. Never use these games, positions or evaluations for training.

opening_reserve.selection: IID seed draws with replacement from reserved pool, fixed before any result
opening_reserve.training_prohibition: All arena games, scores and positions are held out from all learning datasets

resource_guard.scope: Zero observed external named engine CPU ticks; sampled process discovery. Unknown/transient engines between samples and non-engine host load are not excluded. Recognized browsers are monitored by the same native CPU rule. Arbitrary non-browser host workloads, thermal drift and unknown process names are not excluded.

decision.criterion: at least 32 complete clean independent opening pairs at >=100ms per move and one-sided lower bound > 0.5
decision.scope: Declared randomized reserved opening distribution and equal time control only; no Elo claim.

optimistic_final_decision.criterion: at least 32 complete clean independent opening pairs at >=100ms per move and one-sided lower bound > 0.5
optimistic_final_decision.scope: Declared randomized reserved opening distribution and equal time control only; no Elo claim.

futility_certificate.hypothetical_only: unplayed wins bound the final gate; no invented game or result is recorded
futility_certificate.scope: rejection only; shortened observed score is not a full-schedule strength estimate
